builds.name: Reference: Mana burst
builds.goal: Reference for Neeko: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A deceptive pick mage who combines disguises and clones with root setup and a delayed area engage. Compare disguise/R access with empowered W attacks. Record actual attack cadence and passive effects; an AP attack route cannot assume every hit is empowered. AP and penetration support a short spell sequence; Luden supplies mana/proc pressure.
testPlan: Kit question for Neeko: Compare disguise/R access with empowered W attacks. Record actual attack cadence and passive effects; an AP attack route cannot assume every hit is empowered.

Start with the early core (Luden, then Shadowflame) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: AP and penetration support a short spell sequence; Luden supplies mana/proc pressure. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Neeko throws a seed dealing magic damage. The seed blooms again on hitting champions or killing units. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Every 3rd Attack deals an additional [30 / 65 / 100 / 135 / 170 + (0.6) × AP] bonus magic damage and increases Neeko's Move Speed by [10 / 17.5 / 25 / 32.5 / 40]% for [1] second.

Active: Neeko becomes invisible for [0.5 / 0.5 / 0.5 / 0.5 / 0.5] seconds and projects a clone that lasts [3] seconds. Neeko and the clone gain [20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40]% Move Speed for [3] seconds. 

The clone can be controlled using the Move Pet Click hotkey or by Recasting this Ability.
The clone mirrors her spellcasts, emotes, and recall.

After a delay Neeko leaps into the air, Knocking Up all nearby enemies for [0.6 / 0.6 / 0.6] seconds. She then crashes down, dealing [150 / 350 / 550 + (1.2) × AP] magic damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for [0.75 / 0.75 / 0.75] seconds.

This Ability can be prepared in secret if Neeko is disguised. [0.5] seconds after casting this ability Neeko breaks her disguise.

Neeko throws a seed that blooms to deal [60 / 110 / 160 / 210 / 260 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage. If it kills a unit or hits a champion or large monster, it will bloom again, dealing [35 / 60 / 85 / 110 / 135 + (0.25) × AP] magic damage. Max 2 extra blooms.

Neeko can disguise herself as other units on the map. At any time she can disguise as an allied champion, or Neeko can stand next to any allied or neutral unit to store their Sho'ma and be able to transform into it. Your disguise will break upon receiving immobilizing crowd control, casting a damaging spell, damaging enemy towers as a non-champion, or your disguise taking damage equal to its healthbar. 

Neeko gains many of the properties of the units she turns into, negative and positive.

Neeko slings a tangle that deals [80 / 115 / 150 / 185 / 220 + (0.65) × AP] magic damage and Roots for [0.7 / 0.9 / 1.1 / 1.3 / 1.5] seconds.

The tangle becomes empowered after hitting an enemy, growing larger, moving faster, and Rooting for [2 / 2.25 / 2.5 / 2.75 / 3] seconds.
